subject: general
question:
Arrange the sentence parts:

(A) I have never (B) seen such (C) a huge gathering (D) before today
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (4)** i.e. **ABCD**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence follows a logical and grammatically correct sequence:
 
• **Part (A):** "I have never" begins the sentence, introducing the subject.
 
• **Part (B):** "seen such" connects smoothly, describing the action.
 
• **Part (C):** "a huge gathering" adds detail about what was seen.
 
• **Part (D):** "before today" concludes the sentence with a time reference.

Therefore, the correct arrangement is **ABCD.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (ACBD):** This arrangement disrupts the flow by placing "a huge gathering" before "seen such," making the sentence awkward.
 
• **Option 2 (ABDC):** This arrangement places "before today" prematurely, leading to a grammatically incorrect sentence.
 
• **Option 3 (BACD):** Starting with "seen such" misses the introductory subject "I have never," breaking the logical sequence.
